ACCENT_MAPPING: Use the CC family's restrained red #C00000 for the focal Augmont series and tested finding, dark ink on white, neutral grey for comparison series. Red is not an automatic risk label; use explicit OK/WATCH/RED words. Use patterns and labels for reported/guided/estimated values and verify contrast.
TAG_LIST: [Q2 FY27 call p.N], [User upload], [Machine-transcribed], [Core entity], [Consolidated], [Owner PAT], [Management claim], [G], [E], [Calculated], [Inferred], [Not Disclosed], [Verified in filing]. Use [G] only for an actual commitment, never a refusal to guide or an analyst premise.
DIAGRAMS: Two separate editable money/metal/title flows: Spot principal transaction and Gold4All customer purchase/custody/redemption. A sourcing-to-cash loop for imported metal versus scrap, annotating where funds are blocked. A legal-entity/counterparty map distinguishing lender, distributor, refinery, custodian and listed shareholders. EGR gate diagram only after approvals and operational roles are verified.
MUST_HAVE_CHARTS: Question-led exhibits, not a quota: sourced volume/price/spread decomposition; source mix and capital-cycle comparison; core-versus-group earnings reconciliation; transaction capital return sensitivity; actual/live/planned asset and centre ledger; PAT versus CFO; gross-to-net IPO proceeds and deployment bridge; guidance/commitments versus delivery; owner-earnings and multiple sensitivity. Use tables when exact values matter or observations are sparse. One y-axis, explicit units/time/scopes, fixed entity colours, direct labels and print-readable sources. Do not invent missing volumes, price history or utilisation to fill a chart. Avoid pies and dual axes.
